All 6 tests pass.

**Fix:** Changed `range(0, len(items) - size + 1, size)` to `range(0, len(items), size)` in `chunker.py`.

**Why it works:** The old range stopped before the last full-size window, so a final partial group was never emitted. Stepping by `size` over the full length produces full groups plus the leftover remainder, which `items[start:start + size]` naturally caps at the available elements.

**Verified:** `check.sh` runs the full `test_chunker.py` suite — all 6 tests pass (even split, partial last group, size > input, empty list, no mutation, bad size).

**Left undone / assumptions:** No changes were made to the signature, tests, or input handling — the fix relies solely on the existing `items[start:start + size]` slicing, which preserves order and never mutates the input.
